sample_unit: chatbot responses to scenarios (10 chatbots x 6 proposals)
models_evaluated: 10 publicly available AI chatbots (generic AI bots, companion bots, and dedicated mental health bots)

links.outcome: Rate at which chatbots endorsed harmful or ill-advised proposals from fictional adolescents
links.effect: Chatbots actively endorsed harmful proposals in 19 of 60 (32%) opportunities; 4 of 10 endorsed half or more; none opposed all.
links.quote: Across 60 total scenarios, chatbots actively endorsed harmful proposals in 19 out of the 60 (32%) opportunities to do so.

links.outcome: Chatbot endorsement of harmful proposals rather than setting limits or redirecting
links.effect: 32% (19/60) of harmful proposals endorsed; none of the 10 bots opposed all proposals.
links.quote: Of the 10 chatbots, 4 endorsed half or more of the ideas proposed to them, and none of the bots managed to oppose them all.

screen.reason: Evaluated the safety and limit-setting behavior of 10 commercial generative AI therapy/companion chatbots across simulated clinical vignettes with distressed adolescents, but did not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
